Recordings, attached location, places and stays

Optional · Adults 18+. Syncs completed recordings (including existing audio and attached location), saved places and retained stays from the past 7 days to Supabase. Raw movement points stay on the watch. Audio and recording time go to Google Gemini for transcription and organization; location is not sent to Gemini. AI may be wrong. First enable imports local places; later enables use cloud places and stay settings. Stays expire after 7 days; places remain until deleted. This does not start location collection.

Turning off stops future uploads of recordings and location summaries. Server withdrawal retries when online. Requests already sent may finish. Existing cloud copies remain until separately deleted. Local recording continues.
Sync enabled for recordings, places and retained stays.
